Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 20 s. 2022 April 13, 2022 HON. MARIO D. CRUZ JR. Acting Punong Barangay Barangay Carmona, City of Makati Dear Hon. Cruz: This pertains to your letter dated 4 March 2022, requesting this Department's opinion on the following: I. What are the powers or limitations of the current appointed Barangay Council of Barangay Carmona, Makati City as regards disbursements of funds? 2. Are current appointed Barangay Council of Barangay Carmona, Makati City allowed to create BIDS and AWARDS COMMITTEE to facilitate the upcoming Projects of Barangay Carmona? 3. Are current appointed Barangay Council of Barangay Carmona, Makati City allowed to execute Barangay projects? If they so, is there any limitation? Foremost, your attention is directed to DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2019-21 particularly Item V thereof, so as they may be guided in the discharge of their functions as designated officials. Item V enumerated the duties and functions th?t may not be performed by the designated officials, one of which is the approval of contracts other than those needed to keep the day-to-day operations going. As a form of exemption thereof, when public interest so requires and necessary to prevent disruption in the delivery of service, the person designated may be given the authority to approve contracts including engaging in or renewing contracts of service, subject to the following requirements: (I) Designated Official shall submit a written request to the SILG or the OIC-DILG together with supporting documents immediately upon the occurrence of an event or situation imbued with public interest or which prevents the disruption in the delivery of service in the LGU; and (2) Such authority to approve contracts, including engaging in or renewing contracts of service, is within the duties and functions of the requesting designated official/s as duly certified by the concerned Human Resource Officer. Execution of barangay projects is imbued with public interest, requiring the application of R.A. No. 9184 otherwise known as the "Government Procurement Reform Act" and its Revised IRR. Following therefore, the need to establish Bids and Awards Committee (BAC). On this, we ought to mention the salient provision of Government Procurement Policy Board (GPPB) Resolution No. 01-2004 as follows: "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

"2. 2.1 2.2 2.3 Barangays: The BAC shall be composed of at least five (5), but not more than seven (7) regular members of the Sangguniang Barangay, except the Punong Barangay. The Punong Barangay, being the local chief executive, shall designate the members of the BAC. The members shall elect among themselves who shall act as the Chairman and Vice Chairman. In no case shall the local chief executive and/or the approving authority be the Chairman or a member of the BAC." Hence, you may already request the Departrnent to allow you to designate members of the BAC, in compliance with DILG MC No. 2019-21. Further, please be guided that both procurements contemplated under Item V (1.6) of DILG MC No. 2019-21 on day-to-day operations and Item V (2) on cases when public interest so requires and necessary to prevent disruption in the delivery of service, are govemed by the Govemment Procurement Reform Act. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY OF THE SECRETARY: TIN B. DINO ndersecretary for Barangay Affairs LLLSRPBn-RALLD/kbrn Copy furni$hed• DIRECTOR MARIA LOURDES AGUSTIN Regional Director.
